answer: A concrete approach: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by making the twenty-first clone cost more than the first twenty combined, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. An identity earns only when its wander recurs, its glacier survives audit, and a raven from an unlinked peer confirms it.
